### Notes

The funding and headcount limits are explicitly SOFT, not hard gates: "Ideally, applicants will have raised less than $10 million in funding and be under 25 employees, but please apply even if you do not meet these guidelines." Treat funding_max_usd and employees_max as guidelines. What I could NOT inspect: the target URL https://grafana.com/startups/ returns 404, so no current program landing page exists to confirm the offer is still live; the only official description I could open is this announcement blog post dated 2024-09-25. The post states no application deadline, no cohort cap and no closing notice, so status is inferred rather than asserted. The typeform apply link on the page carried ?pg=blog&plcmt=body-txt tracking parameters, which have been stripped. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source. AUDIT: grafana.com/startups/ now returns 404; the only page still carrying these terms is a Grafana Labs blog post. Per the verification policy an announcement page cannot support an active status, so this is recorded as unverified until a live programme page can be cited.
